title: Nourishing Smoky Polish Black Beans Skillet
description: A hearty one-pot Polish dish featuring charred black beans, this skillet is perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a smoky flavor from broiling and satvik-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to char, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked black beans, tomato paste, and vegetable broth to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the skillet to the broiler and cook until the top is lightly charred, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
